detail: The expected result 'There is still exactly one link in the primary navigation' is not in the story, which only requires the Shop all link's text, destination and look to be unchanged. Drop the assertion or limit it to 'exactly one link named Shop all'.

The precondition names item 99 but step 3 says 'click a product card's link' without naming which one. Name the card to click (for example item 99 'Adventurer GPS Watch' if it is on the first catalog page, or the first product card) and the exact URL path expected at step 4.

After clicking 'Shop all' the test asserts pathname '/', but neither the highlight keyframe nor the step keyframe after the click shows the 'After click: <url>' caption. The frames show the catalog grid with no URL, so the recording does not prove the destination (lesson L2).

Step 6 expects URL path '/'. The test asserts it, but keyframes 09 and 10 after the 'Shop all' click show the catalog hero without the 'Back on <url>' caption, so no frame shows the URL after the in-app navigation back.

The highlight frame shows the Shop all pill on the catalog, but the only caption is 'Opened http://localhost:29080/ (catalog)'. The highlight label 'Catalog: Shop all has aria-current="page"' is not visible, and no caption narrates the measured aria-current value, which the video cannot otherwise show (L2).

The frame shows /item/99 and the plain Shop all link, but neither the label 'no aria-current' nor any measurement of getAttribute('aria-current') = null is visible. The absent attribute is never narrated.
The frame shows the /cart page and the plain Shop all link, but the highlight label is missing and no caption narrates the measured absence of aria-current.
The frame shows the /user/orders page and the plain Shop all link, but the highlight label is missing and no caption narrates the measured absence of aria-current.

After clicking Shop all, frames 04 and 05 show the catalog cards scrolled into view with the pill highlighted, but the 'After click: <url>' caption is absent. No frame shows that the resulting path is '/', which the case requires (L2: URL after navigation).

After clicking Shop all back to the catalog, frames 08-10 show the hero and the highlighted pill, but no 'Back on <url>' caption and no narration of aria-current='page'. The step 6 URL and attribute are not shown in the video, and neither is aria-current in step 2 or step 4.
